artifact_lifecycle_matrix.freshness: Exact ProductCandidate and DeliveryHead commits supplied to the validator
artifact_lifecycle_matrix.integrity: Repository-owned validation over task state, ledger, evidence, and generated progress
artifact_lifecycle_matrix.authenticity: Protected history plus explicit current-run maintainer authority
transitions_and_recovery: Reject missing, conflicting, cross-task, or multi-candidate bindings and rebuild only the canonical promotion tail.

artifact_lifecycle_matrix.freshness: Canonical plan validation at the current repository head
artifact_lifecycle_matrix.integrity: Deterministic comparison of declared scope patterns with protected policy paths
artifact_lifecycle_matrix.authenticity: Canonical reviewed plan and repository validator
transitions_and_recovery: Reject a low- or medium-risk future task whose exact or broad scope can cover protected policy paths; reclassify it high before implementation.

authorization_boundary_trace.authority: Canonical M0-14 packet and strict JSON inputs
authorization_boundary_trace.input: ProductCandidate, DeliveryHead, lifecycle artifacts, task scope patterns, and protected paths
authorization_boundary_trace.denied_behavior: Stop before evidence inheritance or task activation when inputs are missing or contradictory

authorization_boundary_trace.authority: Promotion-tail validator and canonical plan validator
authorization_boundary_trace.input: Candidate-bound lifecycle evidence and future task definitions
authorization_boundary_trace.denied_behavior: Do not reuse ambiguous candidate evidence or persist an under-classified task

authorization_boundary_trace.input: Exact allowed paths, four acceptance items, and active gates
authorization_boundary_trace.denied_behavior: Do not change product packages, accepted historical evidence, or M0-13 repair policy

authorization_boundary_trace.authority: Explicit current-run maintainer grant and compiled task scope
authorization_boundary_trace.input: M0-14 scripts, tests, skill, and scoped documentation
authorization_boundary_trace.denied_behavior: Do not modify main directly or write outside the packet

authorization_boundary_trace.input: Focused adversarial tests, plan check, contracts, and repository check
authorization_boundary_trace.denied_behavior: Do not substitute prose or stale review for executable validation

authorization_boundary_trace.input: Push, PR, review, promotion, and merge
authorization_boundary_trace.denied_behavior: Implementation performs no GitHub write or merge

authorization_boundary_trace.authority: Repository CI and protected branch state
authorization_boundary_trace.denied_behavior: Local evidence cannot fabricate external status

normative_adversarial_matrix.invariant: Every lifecycle artifact resolves to exactly one ProductCandidate.
normative_adversarial_matrix.positive: One exact candidate identity is accepted.
normative_adversarial_matrix.missing: An artifact without a candidate identity rejects.
normative_adversarial_matrix.contradictory: Different git_sha and authorized binding candidates reject.
normative_adversarial_matrix.tampered: Multiple task bindings with different candidates reject.
normative_adversarial_matrix.transition_or_recovery: Regenerate the artifact from the exact ProductCandidate.
normative_adversarial_matrix.concurrency: A changed DeliveryHead invalidates the earlier result.

normative_adversarial_matrix.invariant: Broad task scopes cannot evade protected-path high-risk classification.
normative_adversarial_matrix.positive: A high-risk task may declare a protected scope.
normative_adversarial_matrix.missing: A task without usable scope fails existing plan validation.
normative_adversarial_matrix.stale: Accepted historical tasks remain unchanged while new tasks are checked.
normative_adversarial_matrix.contradictory: A low- or medium-risk task covering a protected path rejects.
normative_adversarial_matrix.tampered: scripts/**, .factory/**, product/plans/**, and docs/** cannot hide protected coverage.
normative_adversarial_matrix.transition_or_recovery: Raise the task to high risk and rerun plan validation.
normative_adversarial_matrix.concurrency: A changed plan must pass the validator again before task selection.

attack_cases: A lifecycle artifact names conflicting candidate commits.
A self-asserted marker replaces repository history.
A prior candidate or plan classification is reused after the head changes.
Required progress, task evidence, or candidate identities are omitted.
Promotion precedes exact-candidate validation or task risk validation.
An older ProductCandidate or plan version is substituted.

residual_risks: The local developer runtime remains a trusted host input.
A genuine latest-head P0 or P1 remains blocking and routes to separate corrective work after the bounded review generation.
